message.content: {"decision":"accept","reason":"This GitHub blog post introduces the new GitHub Copilot app feature called 'canvases,' which lets learners create custom, interactive workflows with the agent through natural language prompts, enabling shared, live collaboration and iterative refinement without coding the UI manually.
